description: This file defines a React Native functional component named 'Cell' used in a Tic-Tac-Toe game UI. It renders an interactive cell with styling and accessibility features, displaying either 'X', 'O', or empty based on game state, and handles press events.

methods.name: Cell
methods.description: React functional component rendering a game cell, managing display based on props such as value, highlight, and disabled state, and handling press events.
